description: Job search from one plain-language request, e.g. 'remote senior Rust jobs in Europe over €120k, no crypto'. Use this when you have the user's words rather than filters; with filters in hand, search_jobs gives more control and richer results. Returns ids, titles and URLs, the total, `filters` (how the request was read, reusable with search_jobs) and `broadened` (filters dropped to find any results).

query.description: The request in plain words: stack, level, place, remote, salary floor, things to avoid.
